name: Aerbax's Citadel
title: Aerbax's Citadel (POI)
summary: Aerbax's floating citadel 125-220 m above the Obsidian Plains (65.0S 63.8W), reached through the Harmonic Transference Field in the South Gate. In the kit the South Gate beam (Aerbax Beam spawn) rises from the plain at (9156, 8868) to a cross of four octagonal platforms at z 126; walkways and ramps lead west and east to two 75 m spire halls at (8940, 8868) and (9372, 8868) (z 160-220) and north along x 8940 / 9372 to the core at (9156, 9084): a 120 m square of halls (z 141-168) around a 60 m central spire hall (z 150-210) with four 65 m red pinnacles at its corners (z 111-186). The plain below is at z 2-15.

landmarks.name: South Gate beam and platform cross
landmarks.note: Aerbax Beam spawn at z 16.7; platforms 0x010029FF at z 121.8-126.

site.name: Aerbax's Citadel
site.notes: Derived teleport on the Obsidian Plain 34 m east-south-east of the South Gate beam (the gazetteer South Gate Portal entry lands on the Harmonic Transference Field itself).

shots.standingOrder: Hang 200 m above the Obsidian Plain 330 m south of the floating citadel and drift slowly round it with the sun behind; keep 60 m from the corner towers and walkways.
shots.notes: Signature establishing of the floating citadel from 330 m south (camera z 198 over the Obsidian Plain): the core of halls and the 60 m central spire hall, the four 65 m red pinnacles at its corners, the walkways and ramps of the outer ring at z 126-160 and the plain 190 m below, drifting 10 deg and pushing 8 %; the afternoon sun (0.64, south-west) behind-left. Subject point = the central spire hall. shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up 60 m south-south-west of the South Gate beam, gimbal tilted up, until the cross-shaped platform 110 m above drops into frame; stay 40 m below the platforms.
shots.notes: Vertical boom 60 m south-south-west of the South Gate beam (Aerbax Beam spawn, the Harmonic Transference Field), gimbal tilted +25 deg: rising from 6 m to 40 m above the plain, the beam column stays in frame and the cross-shaped platform 110 m overhead drops into the top of frame from t 6.6 (proj.mjs). The beam's look comes from the ACE spawn at runtime (unverified offline). shots.standingOrder: Cross the citadel's core 26 m above its central spire heading north-north-east at walking pace, gimbal through vertical; keep 20 m above every pinnacle.
